descriptions.zh: 一个未知文明所建立的古老殖民地。尽管没有任何灾难迹象，但很显然这些定居者们突然之间就放弃了这个居住地。这儿到底发生了什么呢？
descriptions.en: An ancient colony from an unknown civilization. Despite no obvious sings of calamity, the settlement was clearly abruptly abandoned by its denizens. What happened here?

sections.en: An ancient colony from an unknown civilization. Despite no obvious sings of calamity, the settlement was clearly abruptly abandoned by its denizens. What happened here?

descriptions.zh: 在被遗弃的泽珞族殖民地中获得的坐标把我们带到了这里。我们需要再次展开探险，调查这颗初看平淡无奇的星球。
descriptions.en: The coordinates provided in abandoned Zroni colony directed us here. We will need to deploy another expedition to explore this seemingly ordinary world.

sections.zh: 在被遗弃的泽珞族殖民地中获得的坐标把我们带到了这里。我们需要再次展开探险，调查这颗初看平淡无奇的星球。
sections.en: The coordinates provided in abandoned Zroni colony directed us here. We will need to deploy another expedition to explore this seemingly ordinary world.

descriptions.zh: 我们之前调查的尽是些被遗弃的殖民地，但依据上一个发掘遗址的指引，[From.Planet.GetName]好像有着一座遗弃的神庙。那个地方为什么对这群人而言具有重要的精神意义呢？
descriptions.en: Previously we have only explored abandoned colonies, but according to the last dig site, [From.Planet.GetName] houses an abandoned shrine. Why would that place be of spiritual significance to this people?

sections.zh: 我们之前调查的尽是些被遗弃的殖民地，但依据上一个发掘遗址的指引，[From.Planet.GetName]好像有着一座遗弃的神庙。那个地方为什么对这群人而言具有重要的精神意义呢？
sections.en: Previously we have only explored abandoned colonies, but according to the last dig site, [From.Planet.GetName] houses an abandoned shrine. Why would that place be of spiritual significance to this people?

descriptions.zh: 从那座泽珞族神庙中我们发现了一个科研复合体的坐标。在轨扫描无法找到任何记忆水晶的共振信号，我们需要下到地表进行进一步研究。
descriptions.en: With the revelations from the Zroni's temple we have obtained the coordinates of a scientific complex. Orbital scans could not detect any resonance from their Memory Crystal, we will need to go down to the surface to learn more.

sections.zh: 从那座泽珞族神庙中我们发现了一个科研复合体的坐标。在轨扫描无法找到任何记忆水晶的共振信号，我们需要下到地表进行进一步研究。
sections.en: With the revelations from the Zroni's temple we have obtained the coordinates of a scientific complex. Orbital scans could not detect any resonance from their Memory Crystal, we will need to go down to the surface to learn more.

descriptions.zh: 之前探索过的所有泽珞族星球，在考古学的重要性上都比不过[From.Planet.GetName]。这颗[From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon]的一些建筑即使从太空上俯瞰都肉眼可见。[From.GetName]一定曾是泽珞帝国的中央星球。
descriptions.en: The archeological significance of all the previously explored Zroni worlds pales in comparison to [From.Planet.GetName]. This [From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon] houses structures visible from space. [From.GetName] must have been a central world of the Zroni empire.

descriptions.zh: 泽珞星可以说是一个灵能活动的漩涡。在我们尝试派遣一个离队小组到地表之前，我们需要对过去用来探测记忆水晶的工具进行重新校准。
descriptions.en: Zron is a maelstrom of psionic activity. The tools we have used to detect Memory Crystals in the past will need to be recalibrated before we can even attempt sending an away team to the surface.

descriptions.zh:
这些遗迹被认为是古代行政建筑群，它们属于一个自称为§Y古茹努尔§!的太空物种，该物种是在[From.Planet.GetName]上被发现的。

令人震惊的是，这个失落的文明似乎在七百万年前就居住在这颗星球上了，我们的考古学家渴望揭开他们的秘密。
descriptions.en:
The remains of what is believed to be an ancient administrative complex, belonging to a space-faring species who called themselves the §YGrunur§! has been found on [From.Planet.GetName].

This fallen civilization appears to have inhabited the planet a staggering seven million years ago, and our archaeologists are eager to uncover their secrets.

The remains of what is believed to be an ancient administrative complex, belonging to a space-faring species who called themselves the §YGrunur§! has been found on [From.Planet.GetName].

This fallen civilization appears to have inhabited the planet a staggering seven million years ago, and our archaeologists are eager to uncover their secrets.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]沉积层的深处，我们发现了一处含有许多植物类物种化石的极有价值的宝库，该物种具有的神经结构足以支撑智能的存在。

如果这些早已死去的生物的确是§Y巴奥§!，研究他们的尸体可能会我们提供更多线索，以便弄清他们那一度草木葱茏的行星是如何变成了一个没有空气和生命的星球。
descriptions.en:
Deep in the geological record of [From.Planet.GetName], a trove of promising fossils belonging to a plantoid species possessing the neurological structures necessary for sapience have been uncovered.

If these long-dead creatures were indeed the §YBaol§!, studying their remains may yield insights into what transformed their once-lush planet into an airless, barren world.

descriptions.zh: 虽然只是前§Y巴奥§!殖民地留下的可悲残片，这一小行星仍有丰富的化石贮藏亟待发掘。我们的考古学家希望能对神秘的§Y巴奥§!的历史和§Y古茹努尔§!在此行星黑暗命运中扮演的可疑角色上有更多的发现。
descriptions.en: The tragic remains of a former §YBaol§! colony, this asteroid nevertheless contains a rich trove of fossils begging for excavation. Our archaeologists hope to discover more about the history of the mysterious §YBaol§!, and the §YGrunur§!'s suspected role in the planet's dark fate.

descriptions.zh: 这一前§Y巴奥§!殖民地上仍然拥有大气层和低等生命，我们已在此建立了一个发掘点，以期能对这一文明最终的历史有更多的了解。
descriptions.en: Still in possession of an atmosphere and lower forms of life, a dig site has been established on this former §YBaol§! colony, in the hopes of shedding more light on the ultimate history of the civilization.
